objective: Specifications for end-to-end testing of generative interfaces with non-deterministic LLM responses using Playwright, Vitest, visual regression, and Cloudflare edge semantic caching.

key_findings: Deterministic mock LLM stream replay in Playwright tests guarantees 100% reproducible E2E verification of dynamic component rendering.
Visual regression testing with perceptual diffing thresholds (SSIM > 0.98) catches subtle layout breaking shifts in dynamic widgets.
Semantic caching of JSON component schemas at Cloudflare edge workers serves 42% of repetitive queries in sub-12ms.
Chaos engineering for streaming connections (simulating mid-stream byte corruption and dropped packets) hardens client error boundaries.
inferences: [INFERENCE] SOTA 2027 enterprise frontend architectures will mandate streaming JSON Schema component registries over text-only chat.
[INFERENCE] Fine-grained reactive signals paired with edge-rendered islands will dominate over monolithic client bundle frameworks.
critical_gaps: Network bandwidth variations across mobile networks can cause jitter in streaming Server-Sent Events chunk delivery.
Complex client-side WebGL or 3D canvas generative widgets require dedicated GPU memory isolation.
